name: @norbert_bodziony/bloub
description: SVG recreation of the x.ai bot avatar. One shape morphing through 14 states, measured off the reference video frame by frame.
author: Jérémy Perret

scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run build:app && bun run build:package
scripts.build:package: vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts && vite build --config vite.lib.ssr.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json
scripts.test:package: bun run build:package && tsc -p tsconfig.package-test.json && bun tests/package-runtime.ts
scripts.pack:check: bun run test:package && bun run test:tarball
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run pack:check
